name: Knowledge Base
description: Multi-source knowledge search (named pgvector collections + LightRAG graphs) with optional Jina router & reranker — injects relevant documents on the user turn (cache-friendly) under a strict latency budget, plus an on-demand knowledge_search tool and a per-agent / per-session policy control plane

enabled.description: Master switch — disables all knowledge injection when false

geminiApiKey.description: Gemini API key used to embed user queries for pgvector search. Supports ${ENV_VAR} substitution.

postgresUrl.description: PostgreSQL connection string for the knowledge database (pgvector). Supports ${ENV_VAR} substitution.

collections.description: Collection names to search in the knowledge_vectors table

topK.description: Maximum number of results returned per collection (raw recall stage)

scoreThreshold.description: Minimum cosine similarity score (0–1) to include a result

maxInjectChars.description: Character budget for pgvector results injected into the prompt

pgvectorEnabled.description: Disable pgvector search while keeping LightRAG. Defaults to true when geminiApiKey is set.

lightragUrl.description: LightRAG server base URL (e.g. http://openclaw-lightrag:9621). Supports ${ENV_VAR} substitution.

lightragApiKey.description: LightRAG API key sent as X-API-Key header. Supports ${ENV_VAR} substitution.

lightragQueryMode.description: Legacy global LightRAG query mode. When set explicitly it overrides every per-route default (pre-4.0 semantics); lightragQueryModeByRoute entries still win over it. When omitted, 4.0 uses per-route defaults (naive for simple lookups and tool calls, hybrid for graph questions).

lightragMaxChars.description: Character budget for LightRAG context injected into the prompt

lightragEnabled.description: Disable LightRAG search while keeping pgvector. Defaults to true when lightragUrl is set.

jina.description: Optional Jina-powered enhancements: router (skip irrelevant retrievals) and pgvector reranker (re-order vector results by cross-encoder relevance).

apiKey.description: Jina API key shared by router and reranker. Required when router.mode=jina-classifier or pgvectorReranker.enabled. Supports ${ENV_VAR} substitution.

rpmBudget.description: Soft RPM budget for ALL outbound Jina calls (router + reranker). When the sliding 60-second window exceeds this number, a jina_rpm_exceeded event is emitted and a warning is logged. The call is NEVER blocked — the existing 429 cooldown is the hard backstop. Default 60 leaves headroom below the Jina free tier ceiling (100 RPM). Set to 0 to disable the monitor.

router.description: Adaptive routing: classify each user turn and skip retrieval when irrelevant.

enabled.description: Enable the router. When false (default), every eligible turn calls every configured source — pre-3.2.0 behavior.

mode.description: heuristic: zero-cost regex + trigger rules only. jina-classifier: heuristics first, then Jina /v1/classify for ambiguous queries (serial: classifier latency adds to the turn). jina-classifier-parallel: same decision, but sources start speculatively in parallel with the classifier and are discarded when the decision is NONE (lower latency, pays the source cost on turns the classifier would have skipped).

classifierId.description: Optional pre-trained Jina classifier_id (few-shot mode). Train it out-of-band via POST /v1/train then paste the ID here. When omitted, the router uses zero-shot with built-in labels.

minConfidence.description: Minimum classifier confidence (cosine similarity 0–1) required to trust a classifier prediction. Scores below this floor fail open to ALL with reason classifier_low_confidence. Default 0.35 — observed noise floor on Jina v3 zero-shot when no label matches.

timeoutMs.description: Timeout for the Jina classify call in ms (also bounded by retrievalBudgetMs). A timeout fails open to ALL.

pgvectorReranker.description: Re-order pgvector results with a Jina cross-encoder. Boosts precision when topK candidates contain noise.

enabled.description: Enable cross-encoder rerank on pgvector results. Requires jina.apiKey.

model.description: Jina reranker model. v2-base-multilingual is recommended for French content (v3 is English-biased).

topN.description: Max number of results returned after rerank. Recommendation: keep topK ≥ topN × 2 so the cross-encoder has room to re-order.

candidatePoolMax.description: Maximum number of cosine-ranked candidates submitted to Jina /v1/rerank per call. Trims Jina token spend on noisy recall. Set to 0 to disable the cap (legacy v3.2.3 behavior).

maxCharsPerDoc.description: Per-candidate text truncation length in characters before submission to Jina. The first ~2000 chars typically carry most of the relevance signal. Set to 0 to disable the truncation.

provenanceReport.description: Provenance reporting toward chat frontends (provenance/v1): off = no emission; metadata = file names/collections/scores; full = plus source excerpts (the injected pgvector chunks, the injected LightRAG context blob, AND each LightRAG source document's retrieved content so the user sees the material the RAG pulled per document). Reports ride the gateway agent-event bus and land under the chat's own ACL — never in logs.

injectionTarget.description: Where the knowledge block is injected. prependContext/appendContext land on the CURRENT user message (model submission only; the transcript keeps the raw text) so the system prompt and history prefix stay cacheable. appendSystemContext is the pre-4.0 behavior (changes the system prompt every turn and breaks prompt caching).

lightragTimeoutMs.description: Abort a LightRAG /query call after this many ms.

pgvectorTimeoutMs.description: Abort the pgvector path (Gemini embedding + SQL, also used as PostgreSQL statement_timeout) after this many ms.

retrievalBudgetMs.description: Global per-turn budget (router + sources). When it elapses, whatever sources already finished are injected (partial success, logged).

hookTimeoutMs.description: Explicit before_prompt_build handler timeout registered with the host. Default retrievalBudgetMs + 1500.

lightragQueryModeByRoute.description: Per-route LightRAG mode. Keys: PGVECTOR_ONLY (simple lookups), LIGHTRAG_ONLY and ALL (graph questions), fallback (ALL reached through classifier fallback / low confidence / error), tool (knowledge_search calls). naive skips LightRAG's LLM keyword extraction.

lightragLocalKeywords.description: Extract hl_keywords/ll_keywords locally (FR+EN stopwords) and send them to LightRAG so it skips its own LLM keyword-extraction call on local/global/hybrid/mix queries. Faster and free, slightly less precise for abstract themes.

skip.description: Non-human turn filters applied before any routing, on every deployment.

sessionPatterns.description: Substrings of ctx.sessionKey that skip retrieval (sub-agent and active-memory recall sessions).

triggers.description: ctx.trigger values that skip retrieval. [] restores the pre-4.0 behavior.

nonHumanInput.description: Skip when ctx.inputProvenance.kind is present and not external_user (inter-session messages, subagent announce/settle, internal system wakes).

allowSourceTools.description: inputProvenance.sourceTool values still retrieved despite nonHumanInput.

acknowledgements.description: Skip whole-message greetings / thanks / short confirmations (FR+EN) on every channel.

cache.description: Per-session in-memory result cache keyed by (agent, session, normalized query, source, retrieval variant).

opik.description: Export content-free retrieval timings (hook and knowledge_search) to Opik as traces: durations, route, policy and source ids only — never the query, retrieved text or session key.

apiKey.description: Opik API key; ${VAR} supported. Defaults to the OPIK_API_KEY environment variable.

includeSkipped.description: Also export turns skipped before routing (heartbeat, sub-agent, acknowledgement, policy off/tool).

sources.description: Named knowledge sources. When omitted they are synthesized from the legacy flat keys (lightragUrl → id "lightrag", collections → id "pgvector").

url.description: LightRAG base URL (falls back to lightragUrl). Supports ${ENV_VAR}.

apiKey.description: LightRAG API key (falls back to lightragApiKey). Supports ${ENV_VAR}.

injection.description: auto: inject every eligible turn. tool: never inject; the model calls knowledge_search. hybrid: inject only when the router is confident (keyword hit or classifier score >= hybridMinScore), otherwise tool only. off: no injection and the tool refuses.

allowedSources.description: Source ids a session, one-shot or tool call MAY select (defaults to sources). Clients can never reach a source outside this list.

lightragQueryMode.description: LightRAG mode override (wins over every route default).

defaults.description: Global default policy for agents without their own entry. Default: injection auto, every enabled source.

agents.description: Per-agent policy keyed by OpenClaw agent id.

injection.description: auto: inject every eligible turn. tool: never inject; the model calls knowledge_search. hybrid: inject only when the router is confident (keyword hit or classifier score >= hybridMinScore), otherwise tool only. off: no injection and the tool refuses.

allowedSources.description: Source ids a session, one-shot or tool call MAY select (defaults to sources). Clients can never reach a source outside this list.

lightragQueryMode.description: LightRAG mode override (wins over every route default).

hybridMinScore.description: hybrid injection: minimum classifier score to inject automatically.

tool.description: On-demand knowledge_search agent tool (optional tool: allowlist it with tools.alsoAllow).

sessionOverrides.description: Honour per-session overrides stored in the session extension.

oneShotTtlMs.description: A one-shot selection not consumed within this delay is ignored.

gatewayMethods.description: Register knowledge.sources / knowledge.policy.get and the policy.* session actions.

testMode.description: TEST mode — mock BOTH sources so the plugin runs in an isolated test environment with no live LightRAG server and no PostgreSQL/pgvector backend. The mocked context is genuinely injected into the agent prompt, so its impact is real and observable downstream (e.g. the agent's LLM call traced via LiteLLM → Langfuse reflects it). Off by default. NEVER enable in production.

enabled.description: Master switch. When true, LightRAG and pgvector return canned data instead of querying a server/DB — and each source counts as enabled even without its URL/credentials. The explicit pgvectorEnabled/lightragEnabled:false toggles still win, so you can mock a single source in isolation. A loud warning is logged at registration.

lightragMockResponse.description: Canned LightRAG context returned in test mode. The token {{query}} (whitespace-tolerant) is replaced with the user's query at runtime. Defaults to a realistic synthetic knowledge-graph context (>200 chars, with a citable reference id) so injection is easy to confirm from the agent's answer.

pgvectorMockResults.description: Canned pgvector hits returned in test mode. Each entry is normalized to a full result row (missing fields → null, missing collection → first configured collection, missing score → 0.8) and sorted by descending score. Defaults to a small realistic synthetic set.

file_name.description: Source document name shown in the injected block.

text.description: Chunk content injected into the prompt.

collection.description: Collection label. Defaults to the first configured collection.

lightragMockReferences.description: Canned LightRAG source references in test mode — a list of source document file_paths. These flow through provenance like real references (v3.2.8+), so a TEST deployment on a live gateway can exercise the LightRAG 'Sources' panel, mirroring pgvectorMockResults for pgvector. Defaults to a small synthetic set aligned with the default mock context. Set to [] for LightRAG with no source attribution.

enabled.label: Auto-inject knowledge
enabled.help: Automatically search and inject relevant documents before each agent turn

geminiApiKey.label: Gemini API Key
geminiApiKey.help: Required for pgvector search. Use ${GEMINI_API_KEY} for env var substitution.

postgresUrl.label: PostgreSQL URL
postgresUrl.help: Connection string for the knowledge database. Supports ${ENV_VAR} substitution.

collections.label: Collections to search
collections.help: Collection names in the knowledge_vectors table (e.g. knowledge_default, knowledge_shared)

topK.label: Top-K per collection
topK.help: Maximum number of results returned per collection (default: 5). When the reranker is enabled, recommended ≥ 2× rerank topN.

scoreThreshold.label: Score threshold
scoreThreshold.help: Minimum cosine similarity 0–1 to include a result (default: 0.3)

pgvectorEnabled.label: Enable pgvector source
pgvectorEnabled.help: Disable pgvector while keeping LightRAG. Defaults to true when geminiApiKey is set.

lightragApiKey.label: LightRAG API Key
lightragApiKey.help: Sent as X-API-Key header. Use ${LIGHTRAG_API_KEY} for env var substitution.

lightragQueryMode.label: LightRAG Query Mode
lightragQueryMode.help: Legacy global mode; overrides the per-route defaults when set. naive (vector), local (entity), global (community), hybrid, mix

lightragEnabled.label: Enable LightRAG source
lightragEnabled.help: Disable LightRAG while keeping pgvector. Defaults to true when lightragUrl is set.

jina.apiKey.label: Jina API Key
jina.apiKey.help: Shared by router and reranker. Use ${JINA_API_KEY} for env var substitution.

jina.router.enabled.label: Enable router
jina.router.enabled.help: Adaptive routing that skips retrieval on heartbeats and meta-questions. Default: false (pre-3.2.0 behavior).

jina.router.mode.label: Router mode
jina.router.mode.help: heuristic: zero-cost rules only. jina-classifier: heuristics + Jina /v1/classify (serial). jina-classifier-parallel: sources start while the classifier runs (faster, costs a retrieval on skipped turns).

jina.router.classifierId.label: Few-shot classifier ID
jina.router.classifierId.help: Optional. When set, the router uses your pre-trained classifier instead of zero-shot labels.

jina.router.minConfidence.label: Classifier min confidence
jina.router.minConfidence.help: Floor on classifier score (0–1). Below this, the router falls back to ALL. Default 0.35 — keeps NONE decisions safe when zero-shot signal is too weak.

jina.router.timeoutMs.label: Classifier timeout (ms)
jina.router.timeoutMs.help: Jina classify timeout. Default 1500. Fails open to ALL.

jina.pgvectorReranker.enabled.label: Enable pgvector reranker
jina.pgvectorReranker.enabled.help: Cross-encoder re-ordering of pgvector results. Requires Jina API key.

jina.pgvectorReranker.topN.label: Reranker top-N
jina.pgvectorReranker.topN.help: Max results returned after rerank. Keep topK ≥ topN × 2.

jina.pgvectorReranker.candidatePoolMax.label: Reranker candidate-pool cap
jina.pgvectorReranker.candidatePoolMax.help: Max candidates submitted to Jina per rerank call. Default 20. Set to 0 to disable the cap.

jina.pgvectorReranker.maxCharsPerDoc.label: Reranker chars-per-doc cap
jina.pgvectorReranker.maxCharsPerDoc.help: Per-candidate text truncation before sending to Jina. Default 2000 chars. Set to 0 to disable truncation.

jina.rpmBudget.label: Jina RPM budget (soft)
jina.rpmBudget.help: Soft alert threshold on outbound Jina calls per minute. Default 60. Never blocks — only logs and emits jina_rpm_exceeded events. Set to 0 to disable.

testMode.enabled.label: TEST mode (mock sources)
testMode.enabled.help: Mock LightRAG + pgvector for infra-less test environments. The mocked context is really injected so its impact is observable. NEVER enable in production.

testMode.lightragMockResponse.label: Mock LightRAG context
testMode.lightragMockResponse.help: Canned LightRAG context for test mode. Use {{query}} to echo the user's query. Defaults to a realistic synthetic graph context.

testMode.pgvectorMockResults.label: Mock pgvector results
testMode.pgvectorMockResults.help: Canned pgvector hits for test mode (file_name/text/score/collection). Defaults to a small realistic synthetic set.

testMode.lightragMockReferences.label: Mock LightRAG sources
testMode.lightragMockReferences.help: Canned LightRAG source file_paths for test mode. Surfaced through provenance as the 'Sources' panel. Defaults to a small synthetic set; set to [] for no source attribution.

injectionTarget.label: Injection target
injectionTarget.help: prependContext (default, cache-friendly user-turn injection), appendContext, or appendSystemContext (pre-4.0, breaks prompt caching).

retrievalBudgetMs.label: Retrieval budget (ms)
retrievalBudgetMs.help: Per-turn budget; partial results are injected when it elapses. Default 4500.

lightragQueryModeByRoute.label: LightRAG mode per route
lightragQueryModeByRoute.help: PGVECTOR_ONLY / LIGHTRAG_ONLY / ALL / fallback / tool → naive|local|global|hybrid|mix.

lightragLocalKeywords.label: Local LightRAG keywords
lightragLocalKeywords.help: Skip LightRAG's LLM keyword extraction by sending locally extracted keywords.

skip.triggers.label: Skipped triggers
skip.triggers.help: Default heartbeat, cron, memory, manual. [] = pre-4.0.

cache.enabled.label: Per-session cache
cache.enabled.help: Cache retrieval results per session for cache.ttlMs (default 10 min).

sources.label: Named sources
sources.help: id → {type, label, description, url/apiKey (lightrag) | collections (pgvector)}. Omit to keep the legacy flat keys.

defaults.label: Default policy
defaults.help: {injection, sources, allowedSources, topK, lightragQueryMode, allowSessionOverrides} for agents without an entry.

hybridMinScore.label: Hybrid min score
hybridMinScore.help: Classifier score required to auto-inject under the hybrid policy. Default 0.45.

tool.enabled.label: knowledge_search tool
tool.enabled.help: Registers the optional tool; expose it with tools.alsoAllow: ["knowledge_search"].

controlPlane.sessionOverrides.label: Session overrides
controlPlane.sessionOverrides.help: Let Atrium / /knowledge change the policy per conversation (validated against the agent allowlist).

controlPlane.command.label: /knowledge command
controlPlane.command.help: Chat command to show or change the policy (bypasses the LLM).

controlPlane.gatewayMethods.label: Gateway methods
controlPlane.gatewayMethods.help: knowledge.sources, knowledge.policy.get and the policy.* session actions.
